3	from __future__ import annotations

5	import argparse
6	import re
7	import sys

9	SENTENCE_SPLIT = re.compile(r"[。！？!?]|\n")
10	ITEM_LINE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:[-*•]|\d+[.)、．])\s")
11	
12	
13	def count_sentences(text: str) -> int:
14	    return sum(1 for part in SENTENCE_SPLIT.split(text) if part.strip())
15	
16	
17	def count_chars(text: str) -> int:
18	    return sum(1 for ch in text if not ch.isspace())
19	
20	
21	def count_items(text: str) -> int:
22	    return sum(1 for line in text.splitlines() if ITEM_LINE.match(line))
23	
24	
25	def missing_requirements(text: str, requirements: list[str]) -> list[str]:
26	    return [req for req in requirements if req not in text]
27	
28	
29	def check(
30	    text: str,
31	    max_sentences: int | None,
32	    max_chars: int | None,
33	    max_items: int | None,
34	    require: list[str],
35	) -> list[str]:
36	    failures: list[str] = []
37	    sentences = count_sentences(text)
38	    if max_sentences is not None and sentences > max_sentences:
39	        failures.append(f"sentences {sentences} > {max_sentences}")
40	    chars = count_chars(text)
41	    if max_chars is not None and chars > max_chars:
42	        failures.append(f"chars {chars} > {max_chars}")
43	    items = count_items(text)
44	    if max_items is not None and items > max_items:
45	        failures.append(f"items {items} > {max_items}")
46	    missing = missing_requirements(text, require)
47	    if missing:
48	        failures.append("missing: " + ", ".join(missing))
49	    return failures
50	
51	
52	def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
53	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
54	        description=("Check a file's draft answer against countable limits and required facts.")
55	    )
56	    parser.add_argument(
57	        "--max-sentences",
58	        type=int,
59	        help=(
60	            "reject if the file has more sentences than this; a sentence is a run of "
61	            "text separated by 。！？!? or a newline, trimmed and non-empty"
62	        ),
63	    )
64	    parser.add_argument(
65	        "--max-chars",
66	        type=int,
67	        help="reject if the file has more non-whitespace characters than this",
68	    )

70	        "--max-items",
71	        type=int,
